name: Kopran Limited

revenue and profit both fell QoQ with profit barely up YoY
revenue growth under 15% YoY without 30%+ profit growth
margin fell QoQ and is not up YoY

annual_report.business: Kopran Limited operates through two complementary pharmaceutical business verticals comprising Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Formulations, developing active pharmaceutical ingredients and manufacturing high-quality finished dosage forms across the pharmaceutical value chain.
key_risks: Volatility in prices of raw materials (especially Amoxicillin Trihydrate) impacting inventory valuation
Foreign currency risk on imported raw materials
Recoverability of overdue trade receivables requiring significant judgement for allowance estimation

latest_guidance.statement: Panoli plant expected to contribute INR150-200 crores in FY25-26 and INR200-250 crores over 3 years
Consolidated revenue growth guided at 15% for FY26 and 20% for FY27
API segment revenue growth guided at 10-12% for FY26 and ~20% for FY27
Revenue target revised to around INR1,200 crores in 3.5 years from earlier INR1,300 crores
Expect to participate in 14-15% diagnostic industry growth plus new divisions and South region expansion with Kopran global support attracting more multinational partnerships
